body:
You are disposing the `godot_node_path` you are about to return. Use `CreateTakingOwnershipOfDisposableValue` to make it more explicit and don't dispose it.

```suggestion
            return CreateTakingOwnershipOfDisposableValue(slicedNodePath);
```
